newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at light levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at light levels.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were again quoted at light levels in bids and offers on Tuesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus none on Monday.
- One barge, Illinois River, this week, bid 100 percent of tariff, unchanged from Monday, similar, no offer.
- Two barges, St Paul-Savage, upper Mississippi River, this week, 137-1/2 percent, no comparison, no offer.
- Two barges, Lift top, St Louis, this week, no bid, offer 95 percent, no comparison.
Eight barges, Illinois River, two each week of July, no bid, offer 107-1/2 percent, unchanged from June 13.
